title: VaultBrokerClientAdapter
responsibility: Calls the Credential Vault broker over its Unix socket.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerClientAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Broker socket path and an optional timeout, 10 s by default.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerClientAdapter.call.body
inputs.unknownReason: Each route has its own body; the broker validates it.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerClientAdapter.call
outputs.description: The decoded JSON body of a 2xx response.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 504 'Broker timed out.' when no response arrives within the timeout.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 503 'The Credential Vault broker is not reachable.' when the socket cannot be reached.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: The broker's status and error message, or 'Broker refused the call.', for any non-2xx response.
